'''Tatooine: Cantina''' is the Japanese-language printing of [[Tatooine: Cantina (Dark)|Tatooine: Cantina]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：カンティーナ（酒場）</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-290o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここにいるエイリアンにそれぞれ没収値＋１。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">タスケン・レイダーを除く、ここにいるエイリアンにそれぞれ戦闘力＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
No lore is printed on this card.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Tatooine: Cantina.

'''Light Side:''' Each alien here is forfeit +1.

'''Dark Side:''' Each alien here except Tusken Raiders is power +1.
